visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dyed reddish-pink hair stands in front of a white building with a patterned glass door. She wears a white t-shirt and black trousers, gesturing towards the door with her right hand. The lighting is bright and natural, reflecting an outdoor environment with a white wall and some greenery to the right. (2) As the door opens, the scene shifts to a very clean bathroom interior. It features large grey wall tiles, decorative patterned tiles near the center, a white porcelain toilet, and a urinal. A glass partition separates the toilet area from a shower space with a silver showerhead and wall-mounted soap dispensers. (3) The camera zooms into a close-up of the tile grout in the shower area. A person's hand points at the clean, white lines between the grey textured tiles to emphasize the absence of mold or dirt. The lighting is even and bright from indoor bathroom fixtures. (4) The scene transitions to an outdoor common area under a metal roof structure. It contains a stainless steel water dispenser, sinks, and a wooden table where two hair dryers are mounted on the wall. In the background, there are large white and black commercial refrigerators or freezers. (5) The camera pans out to a wide shot of a grassy campsite surrounded by misty green mountains. A black pickup truck with a rooftop tent and a silver camper van are parked on the grass. People are seen relaxing near the vehicles with camping gear spread out. Potted palms line a stone path.
